title: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog (test subset)

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products ImageIO Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in ImageIO when processing a maliciously crafted image, which may lead to arbitrary code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products CoreGraphics Integer Overflow Vulnerability (FORCEDENTRY)
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, watchOS, and iPadOS contain an integer overflow vulnerability in CoreGraphics that allows for code execution when processing a maliciously crafted PDF.
